title: Optimize the interface of your Mac Catalyst app
description: Discover how to tailor your Mac Catalyst app so that it looks and feels even more at home on the Mac by using the new “Optimize Interface for Mac” option in Xcode. Explore new layout and appearance options for Catalyst apps, and learn how they can provide you with graphical performance gains, sharper text, and an interface designed specifically for Apple’s desktops and laptops. We’ll show you how to take advantage of these options and provide best practices for organizing your code when developing for multiple platforms. Developers actively working on a Mac Catalyst project will get the most out of watching this session. If you’re new to Catalyst, we recommend watching “Designing iPad Apps for Mac” and "Introducing iPad Apps for Mac" for an introduction. For more on working with Mac Catalyst, check out "What's new in Mac Catalyst”
